facts.text: The hotel is situated within the Water Street Tampa neighborhood.
facts.excerpt: Situated within the new 56-acre Water Street Tampa neighborhood

facts.text: The building was designed by New York-based architecture practice Morris Adjmi in collaboration with Florida-based firm Nichols Brosch Wurst Wolfe & Associates.

facts.text: Lilac is a Mediterranean restaurant helmed by Chef John Fraser, using Floridian ingredients.

facts.text: Lilac has an open kitchen and an eight-seat chef's counter designed by Christian Liaigre.

Azure at EDITION is a rooftop restaurant with floor-to-ceiling windows serving seaside-inspired Greek cuisine.
facts.excerpt: rooftop with floor-to-ceiling windows, Azure at EDITION serves seaside-inspired Greek cuisine in an elevated, airy atmosphere

facts.text: Azure at EDITION offers Sunday brunch.
